stem: A primary molar has just completed non-vital pulp therapy. Which statement about the type and timing of the final restoration is supported by the evidence and recommendations?

options.text: At 12 months, stainless steel crowns and fillings perform comparably regardless of when the final restoration is placed.
Success at 12 months depends heavily on placing the final restoration at the same visit as the pulp therapy.
At 12 months, stainless steel crowns and fillings differ markedly in success.
Restoration type and timing are fixed by a mandatory protocol that leaves no room for clinician preference.
